<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Global Renewable Energy in 2025: How Far Have We Come?</title>

    <!-- Electric Studio: Manrope 400/500/700/800 -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (THEME)
           Electric Studio — bold, clean, high contrast
           Adapted for energy/policy analytics context
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            --bg-dark:         #0b0e17;
            --bg-panel:        #111827;
            --bg-card:         #1c2333;
            --bg-card-hover:   #22293d;
            --accent-primary:  #2dd4bf;   /* teal — renewable / clean energy */
            --accent-warm:     #f59e0b;   /* amber — fossil fuel / urgency */
            --accent-solar:    #fbbf24;
            --accent-wind:     #60a5fa;
            --accent-hydro:    #34d399;
            --text-primary:    #f1f5f9;
            --text-secondary:  #94a3b8;
            --text-muted:      #4b5563;
            --border:          rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
            --border-accent:   rgba(45,212,191,0.3);

            --font-display: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
            --font-mono:    'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* viewport-base.css typography — ALL use clamp() */
            --title-size:    clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size:       clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            --h3-size:       clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            --body-size:     clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.125rem);
            --small-size:    clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap:   clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap:   clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration:      0.65s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS — mandatory base styles
           =========================================== */
        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED LAYOUT ELEMENTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Slide-level background grid */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* Slide number badge */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        /* Teal accent bar (left edge) */
        .accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0; top: 10%; bottom: 10%;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* Source caption */
        .source-tag {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            z-index: 10;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATION: .reveal → triggered by .visible
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* Stagger delays for children */
        .stagger > *:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-wind));
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.75vw, 0.6rem);
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-primary);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           Full-bleed, centered, hero treatment
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
        }

        /* Large decorative radial glow */
        .title-slide::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%; left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: min(80vw, 700px);
            height: min(60vh, 500px);
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center,
                rgba(45,212,191,0.12) 0%,
                rgba(96,165,250,0.06) 50%,
                transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            background: rgba(45,212,191,0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.25);
            padding: 0.3em 1em;
            border-radius: 100px;
        }

        .title-main {
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            max-width: min(80vw, 900px);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .title-main em {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            font-style: normal;
        }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vw, 1.15rem);
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: min(70vw, 700px);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .title-meta {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — FOSSIL FUEL URGENCY
           =========================================== */
        .urgency-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .urgency-heading {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .urgency-heading .highlight-warm {
            color: var(--accent-warm);
        }

        .stat-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.75vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .stat-card.warm { border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.35); }
        .stat-card.danger { border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.35); }

        .stat-big {
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .stat-big.warm  { color: var(--accent-warm); }
        .stat-big.red   { color: #f87171; }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .urgency-body {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.7;
            max-width: 80ch;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — PRIMARY ENERGY SHARE (with map)
           =========================================== */
        .map-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .slide-heading {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .slide-heading .teal { color: var(--accent-primary); }
        .slide-heading .amber { color: var(--accent-warm); }

        .map-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.7fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .map-callouts {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .callout-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-primary);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .callout-item.warm { border-left-color: var(--accent-warm); }
        .callout-item.muted { border-left-color: var(--text-muted); }

        .callout-title {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .callout-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            margin-top: 0.15em;
        }

        .map-img-wrap {
            max-height: min(46vh, 380px);
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .map-img-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            max-height: min(46vh, 380px);
            display: block;
        }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .map-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .map-img-wrap { max-height: min(35vh, 250px); }
            .map-img-wrap img { max-height: min(35vh, 250px); }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — RENEWABLE ELECTRICITY GROWTH
           Bar chart visualization
           =========================================== */
        .chart-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .chart-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.65rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .chart-bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .chart-label {
            width: clamp(70px, 12vw, 120px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .chart-bar-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(22px, 3.5vh, 40px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .chart-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transform-origin: left center;
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-right: 0.5em;
        }

        .slide.visible .chart-bar { transform: scaleX(1); }

        .chart-bar.hydro  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-hydro), rgba(52,211,153,0.7)); transition-delay: 0.1s; }
        .chart-bar.wind   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-wind),  rgba(96,165,250,0.7));  transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .chart-bar.solar  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-solar), rgba(251,191,36,0.7));  transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        .chart-bar.other  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a78bfa, rgba(167,139,250,0.7));             transition-delay: 0.4s; }

        .chart-bar-val {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--bg-dark);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .chart-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .chart-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 3px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .legend-dot.hydro  { background: var(--accent-hydro); }
        .legend-dot.wind   { background: var(--accent-wind); }
        .legend-dot.solar  { background: var(--accent-solar); }
        .legend-dot.other  { background: #a78bfa; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — ELECTRICITY MIX (map + data table)
           =========================================== */
        .elec-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .data-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .data-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .data-table th {
            text-align: left;
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.75rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .data-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }

        .data-table td.country-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .data-table td.share-val { color: var(--accent-primary); font-weight: 600; }
        .data-table td.share-low { color: var(--accent-warm); font-weight: 600; }

        .share-bar-cell { width: 35%; }

        .share-mini-bar {
            height: clamp(5px, 0.7vh, 8px);
            border-radius: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-primary);
            opacity: 0.75;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .share-mini-bar.low { background: var(--accent-warm); }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .elec-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — HYDROPOWER (map + text)
           =========================================== */
        .hydro-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .hydro-stats {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .big-stat-block {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.25);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .big-stat-num {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-hydro);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .big-stat-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.25em;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .leader-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vw, 0.45rem);
        }

        .leader-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.35rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
        }

        .leader-rank {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            width: 1.5em;
        }

        .leader-name {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .leader-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-hydro);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .hydro-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7 — WIND & SOLAR GROWTH
           =========================================== */
        .windsolar-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .tech-compare {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .tech-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
        }

        .tech-card.wind  { border-color: rgba(96,165,250,0.35); }
        .tech-card.solar { border-color: rgba(251,191,36,0.35); }

        .tech-card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
            margin-bottom: 0.5em;
        }

        .tech-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .tech-name {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .tech-card.wind .tech-name  { color: var(--accent-wind); }
        .tech-card.solar .tech-name { color: var(--accent-solar); }

        .tech-gen {
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .tech-card.wind .tech-gen  { color: var(--accent-wind); }
        .tech-card.solar .tech-gen { color: var(--accent-solar); }

        .tech-share {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }

        .tech-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: 0.3em;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .combined-stat {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(96,165,250,0.08), rgba(251,191,36,0.08));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .combined-stat strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .windsolar-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8 — REGIONAL DISPARITIES
           =========================================== */
        .regional-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: start;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        .disparity-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .disparity-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
        }

        .disparity-item.leader { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-primary); border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; }
        .disparity-item.laggard { border-left: 3px solid #f87171; border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; }

        .disparity-region {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .disparity-item.leader  .disparity-region { color: var(--accent-primary); }
        .disparity-item.laggard .disparity-region { color: #f87171; }

        .disparity-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            margin-top: 0.15em;
        }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .regional-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 9 — KEY TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .takeaway-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-content: start;
        }

        .takeaway-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.4em;
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(1) { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(2) { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent-hydro); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(3) { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent-wind); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(4) { border-top: 2px solid #f87171; }

        .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .takeaway-headline {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .takeaway-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .cta-strip {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.08), rgba(96,165,250,0.08));
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .cta-strip strong { color: var(--accent-primary); }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .takeaway-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- Progress bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"></div>

    <!-- Navigation dots -->
    <nav class="nav-dots" id="navDots" aria-label="Slide navigation"></nav>

    <!-- ================================================
         SLIDE 1 — TITLE
         ================================================ -->
    <section class="slide title-slide" data-slide="1" aria-label="Title slide">
        <div class="slide-content stagger">
            <p class="title-eyebrow reveal">Global Energy Report · 2025</p>
            <h1 class="title-main reveal">
                Global Renewable Energy in 2025:<br>
                <em>How Far Have We Come?</em>
            </h1>
            <p class="title-sub reveal">
                A data-driven overview of renewable energy's growing share in the global energy
                and electricity mix — spanning hydropower, wind, and solar technologies.
            </p>
            <p class="title-meta reveal">
                Data: Our World in Data · Ember (2026) · Energy Institute Statistical Review (2025)
            </p>
        </div>
        <div class="slide-num">01 / 09</div>
    </section>

    <!-- ================================================
         SLIDE 2 — FOSSIL FUEL URGENCY
         ================================================ -->
    <section class="slide urgency-slide" data-slide="2" aria-label="Fossil fuel urgency context">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="slide-content stagger">
            <h2 class="urgency-heading reveal">
                <span class="highlight-warm">75%</span> of Global GHG Emissions<br>
                Still Come from Fossil Fuels
            </h2>

            <div class="stat-row reveal">
                <div class="stat-card warm">
                    <div class="stat-big warm">75%</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">of global greenhouse gas emissions<br>from fossil fuel combustion</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-card danger">
                    <div class="stat-big red">5M+</div>
                    <div class="stat-label">premature deaths annually from<br>fossil fuel air pollution</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <p class="urgency-body reveal">
                Since the Industrial Revolution, most countries' energy systems have become dominated
                by fossil fuels. Three-quarters of global greenhouse gas emissions come from burning
                fossil fuels for energy — and combustion-related air pollution causes at least
                5 million premature deaths per year. Rapidly shifting to low-carbon sources
                — nuclear and renewables — is imperative for both climate and public health.
            </p>
        </div>
        <div class="slide-num">02 / 09</div>
        <div class="source-tag">Source: Our World in Data — Renewable Energy (2025)</div>
    </section>

    <!-- ================================================
         SLIDE 3 — PRIMARY ENERGY SHARE (~14%)
         ================================================ -->
    <section class="slide map-slide" data-slide="3" aria-label="Renewables in primary energy mix">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="slide-content stagger">
            <h2 class="slide-heading reveal">
                Renewables Now Supply <span class="teal">~14%</span><br>of Global Primary Energy
            </h2>

            <div class="map-layout reveal">
                <div class="map-callouts stagger">
                    <div class="callout-item">
                        <div class="callout-title">~14% of primary energy</div>
                        <div class="callout-body">Roughly one-seventh of total global primary energy (electricity, transport & heating combined) came from renewables as of 2024 — measured using the substitution method.</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="callout-item">
                        <div class="callout-title">Why lower than electricity?</div>
                        <div class="callout-body">Transport and heating remain far more reliant on oil and gas — pulling the overall share well below the electricity-sector figure of ~30%.</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="callout-item warm">
                        <div class="callout-title">Strong regional variation</div>
                        <div class="callout-body">Norway, Brazil, and New Zealand derive large shares from renewables; fossil-fuel producers in the Middle East and parts of Asia remain below 5%.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="map-img-wrap">
                    <img src="../benchmark/assets/figure_2.jpg"
                         alt="Map showing share of primary energy from renewables by country, 2024"
                         loading="lazy">
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="slide-num">03 / 09</div>
        <div class="source-tag">Figure 2 · Our World in Data (2024, substitution method)</div>
    </section>

    <!-- ================================================
         SLIDE 4 — RENEWABLE ELECTRICITY GENERATION GROWTH
         Bar chart by technology
         ================================================ -->
    <section class="slide chart-slide" data-slide="4" aria-label="Renewable electricity generation by technology">
        <div class="accent-bar"></div>
        <div class="slide-content stagger">

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Keyboard, mouse, touch navigation + animations
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides     = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.current    = 0;
                this.scrolling  = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsEl   = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.buildNavDots();
                this.setupObserver();
                this.setupKeyboard();
                this.setupTouch();
                this.setupWheel();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* ----- Build nav dots ----- */
            buildNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    this.navDotsEl.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsEl.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
            }

            /* ----- Intersection Observer: add .visible on entry ----- */
            setupObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.current = idx;
                            this.updateDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            /* ----- Update UI state ----- */
            updateDots(idx) {
                this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.totalSlides > 1
                    ? (idx / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100
                    : 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
                this.progressBar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(pct));
            }

            /* ----- Navigate to slide index ----- */
            goTo(idx) {
                const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.totalSlides - 1, idx));
                this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* ----- Keyboard navigation ----- */
            setupKeyboard() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
                    const down = ['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', 'PageDown', ' '];
                    const up   = ['ArrowUp',   'ArrowLeft',  'PageUp'];
                    if (down.includes(e.key)) { e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.current + 1); }
                    if (up.includes(e.key))   { e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.current - 1); }
                    if (e.key === 'Home')     { e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0); }
                    if (e.key === 'End')      { e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.totalSlides - 1); }
                });
            }

            /* ----- Touch / swipe navigation ----- */
            setupTouch() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                        delta > 0 ? this.goTo(this.current + 1) : this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* ----- Mouse wheel navigation (throttled) ----- */
            setupWheel() {
                document.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
                    if (this.scrolling) return;
                    this.scrolling = true;
                    e.deltaY > 0 ? this.goTo(this.current + 1) : this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                    setTimeout(() => { this.scrolling = false; }, 900);
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        /* Boot when DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>

print("Done — images embedded as base64")
